metadata.section: Chapter 22: ASSOCIATIVE-EFFECTS, INCLUSIVE FITNESS, AND FISHER'S THEOREM
subsections: ASSOCIATIVE-EFFECTS, INCLUSIVE FITNESS, AND FISHER'S THEOREM
metadata.source_title: Evolution and Selection of Quantitative Traits

blocks.content: We conclude by examining some of the important implications for evolution when heritable associative effects $ \left( \sigma^{2}\left( A_{s}\right) >0\right) $ are present. First and foremost, their presence has significant implications on the evolution of mean population fitness (Bijma 2010a), which forms the subject of this section.
